action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Try cap sync again
c.exec_command("""export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64
export ANDROID_HOME=~/android-sdk
cd /opt/areloria/client
npx cap sync android 2>&1""")

print("Synced!")

# Check files now
c.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/client/android/")

c.close()
EOF
